commands.name: publish

options.name: --candidate
options.description: Candidate mode (proposal 0028): route packages to  the candidate channel instead of release routing. Ignores PUBLISH_PUBLIC arming; public-tier candidates follow publish.candidates.target ('private'  default, or 'public' for prerelease-versioned candidates on the public feed).

options.name: --ci
options.description: Confirm live pushes non-interactively (CI  usage).

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Confirm live pushes (interactive usage).  Equivalent to --ci.

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Repo root whose policy drives the routing  (default: current directory).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the route table and stop — no pushes.

options.name: --expect-ids
options.description: Fail-closed package allowlist (one id per line, #  comments): the packed set must EQUAL this list — missing, unexpected, or  duplicate ids abort BEFORE any push (KANCLI491). Point it at a deployment-owned  file so a hostile build stage cannot smuggle package selection through the  artifact.

options.name: --journal
options.description: Record every package→destination outcome to  FILE, atomically after each feed operation — a failed multi-feed publish  leaves an observable, resumable state (KANCLI499 carries the path).

options.name: --packed-dir
options.description: Directory holding the `dotnet pack`  output to route (required).

options.name: --plan
options.description: Verify the packed set against a previously written release plan BEFORE any push: identical identities, bytes, routing, and  policy-input digests — any difference aborts (KANCLI493/494). The plan is  the reviewed expectation; this run's recomputation is authoritative (0019  §4.3).

options.name: --preflight
options.description: With --dry-run: classify every  package→destination operation against the AS-IF-ARMED release routes (the  routes an armed publish would take — never the ambient unarmed routing) and fail on any non-publishable verdict. Build-stage evidence (0029 §2); live  pushes always preflight.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Expand a policy-declared release profile  (releaseProfiles.<NAME>, 0029 §9): a coordinate bundle over a  semantic mode (evidence/candidate/release). Combinable only with runtime inputs  (--packed-dir, --cwd, --ci/--confirm, --resume); profile-owned flags contradict  (KANCLI504). Profiles never authorize: --ci/--confirm and PUBLISH_PUBLIC stay  external.

options.name: --resume
options.description: Resume from a prior journal: requires --plan,  rejects a journal from another plan (KANCLI496), skips operations proven  complete, retries the rest.

options.name: --skip-preflight
options.description: Skip the pre-mutation feed preflight  (reachability, existing-version byte comparison). Escape hatch for feeds without a queryable flat container — --skip-duplicate remains the only duplicate  handling, which proves nothing about existing bytes.

options.name: --write-plan
options.description: Serialize the deterministic release plan (schema  v1: identities, exact nupkg SHA-256, canonical payload digests, tiers,  destination roles, policy digests) to FILE. Valid with --dry-run for  build/approval evidence (Core proposal 0019 §4).

options.name: --write-preflight
options.description: Write the preflight-verdicts evidence document  (schema v1: per-operation resolved source + verdict) to FILE —  atomically, BEFORE any failure. Valid with --dry-run --preflight and on live  publishes.
